plans.name: Gold
plans.summary: For homes that sit quiet between seasonal stays.
features: Interior and exterior check for leaks, pests, heat and break-ins
Photo report emailed after every visit
Freeze and storm checks after severe weather

plans.name: Platinum
plans.summary: For owners who want eyes on the house every week.
features: Weekly walkthroughs instead of twice a month
Run faucets, flush toilets and cycle appliances
Arrival prep: heat up, lights on, driveway checked

plans.name: Diamond
plans.summary: For owners who want one local contact for everything.
features: Up to four extra visits a month, whenever you ask
Meet contractors, cleaners and delivery crews on site
Groceries and firewood stocked before you arrive
Seasonal checklists for snow load and wildfire defensible space
